## RX-TX-Tracker v2.0.36

### Release summary
- Import workflow is now simpler for operators: patient import exposes a single template download that includes headers plus one editable example row.
- Patient import continues to support RX workflow step dates and automatically creates the matching RX tracking sequence when those dates are present.
- Patient name fields remain normalized (uppercase) during import for consistency in search and matching.

### What’s included
- Patient import template and UI simplification:
  - `controllers/importController.js`
  - `public/js/import.js`
  - `views/import.ejs`
- Removed separate patient import sample file alternatives from UI download flow:
  - `public/samples/import/clinics_import_sample.csv`
  - `public/samples/import/patient_transport_import_sample.csv`
  - `public/samples/import/patients_import_sample.csv`
  - `public/samples/import/pharmacies_import_sample.csv`
  - `public/samples/import/pharmacy_transport_import_sample.csv`
  - `public/samples/import/users_import_sample.csv`
  - `public/samples/import/workflow_actions_import_sample.csv`
- Version/manifests updated for this release:
  - `package.json`
  - `CHANGELOG.md`
  - `OPERATIONS_MANUAL.md`
- Build artifact generated for server deployment:
  - `dist/server-update-2.0.36.zip`

### QA check list
- [x] Confirm import template downloads as a single CSV action.
- [x] Verify RX workflow auto-fill still occurs when step date columns are present.
- [x] Verify name capitalization normalizes on import.
- [x] Build and package executable with `npm run build:exe`.
